================================================================================
empty string
================================================================================

locals {
  x = ""
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (literal_value
            (string_lit)))))))

================================================================================
string with content
================================================================================

locals {
  x = "hello world"
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (template_expr
            (quoted_template)))))))

================================================================================
string with interpolation
================================================================================

locals {
  x = "Hello, ${var.name}!"
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (locals_block
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (template_expr
            (quoted_template
              (template_interpolation
                (expression
                  (expression
                    (variable_expr
                      (identifier)))
                  (get_attr
                    name: (identifier)))))))))))
